meta.notes: An area: a box of the overworld from 20 64 20 to 26 66 26, both corners inside. Its tick function tags the players who walk in and runs the hook a rule listens to, and the same when they walk out. Resetting it removes the mobs and items in it and places msm_examples:example_pen_fence again. Run the reset with /function msm_examples:msm_games/area/example_pen/reset or the Rules step Rebuild an area.
